snapshot_note: Frozen Rung-0 baseline before adding another VDM mechanism

claims.claim: For the declared Origin→Transition relation, source-wide heat routing is more concentrated in the designated destination than source-fixed identity permutations on the same weighted topology.
claims.decisive_evidence: pair origin_to_transition omnibus all_reachable median-delta and pass-count tests
claims.decision_rule: PASS only if both median_delta_p_right <= 0.01 and pass_count_p_right <= 0.01 using independent calibration/evaluation null streams.
claims.falsifier: Either omnibus p-value exceeds 0.01, or the runtime-equivalence/negative-control gates fail.

claims.claim: The declared Origin→Transition relation exhibits source-wide natural multi-hop enrichment for targets with no direct related node in the top-12 diffusion neighborhood.
claims.decision_rule: PASS only if median_delta_p_right <= 0.01 and pass_count_p_right <= 0.01; node anecdotes alone do not satisfy this claim.
claims.falsifier: The natural-multihop omnibus fails either decision rule or has fewer than 3 eligible targets.

claims.claim: The routing signature is not merely an artifact of pulse amplitude, diffusion being disabled, or best-target selection.
claims.decisive_evidence: heat-scale robustness, zero-diffusion negative control, maximum-delta omnibus, and all-target sweep
claims.decision_rule: PASS when zero-diffusion foreign AUC is zero within 1e-12, heat-scale max fraction deviation <= configured tolerance, and the maximum-delta omnibus is reported alongside source-wide statistics.

claims.claim: The qualitative source-routing organization is characterized across the predeclared MCR/AC source family on one frozen organism state.
claims.decisive_evidence: source routing matrix with BH-adjusted cell tests and residual OTHER_FOREIGN shares
claims.decision_rule: CHARACTERIZATION; no single PASS is assigned. Report all cells and residual foreign heat without post-hoc source selection.
claims.falsifier: Selected source provenance overlaps ambiguously or the matrix stage cannot complete on the frozen snapshot.

claims.claim: The Origin→Transition routing signature is not wholly dependent on the historical document ingestion order used to build the online graph.
claims.decisive_evidence: document-order sensitivity replay after exact stored-topology reproduction
claims.decision_rule: SENSITIVITY ONLY; report stored-order position within the randomized-order distribution and edge-Jaccard distribution. Do not interpret this stage as a semantic null p-value.
claims.falsifier: Exact graph replay fails; in that case order sensitivity is BLOCKED rather than guessed.
